title: Aphids, whiteflies and mites
category: Food growing · Pest and disease control
summary: Use identification, water management, physical removal and beneficial insects before escalation.
steps: Confirm the pest on leaf undersides with a hand lens when possible.
Isolate heavily infested container plants and remove only severely damaged growth.
Use a controlled water spray where the plant tolerates it, avoiding disease-promoting prolonged wetness.
Reduce excess nitrogen and protect beneficial insects; avoid broad-spectrum treatment without need.
If a labelled product is necessary, cover the full target area exactly as the label directs and observe the harvest interval.
